name.ja: Gaussian確率測度：尾確率と相関標的
name.en: Gaussian probability measures: tails and correlated targets

note.ja: 確率密度と積分のモデル。通常の重要度重みと既知分散の区間、2D相関Gaussianの量別診断を区別し、物理時間発展や一般のMCMC収束保証とは扱いません。
note.en: A probability-density/integration model. Separate ordinary importance weights/known-variance intervals and observable-specific2D Gaussian diagnostics; no physical-time or universal MCMC-convergence claim.

equation_note.ja: 平均(1,-1)、相関.95・対角分散1。4独立chainset×4chain、burn1024/draw8192、prefix2048/8192。固定.9Lzと.25z、適応なし。

note.en: Test actual2D MH paths against known joint moments and same-data ArviZ diagnostics.

title.en: Joint target and MCSE for a correlated bivariate Gaussian

assumptions.ja: 平均(1,-1)、相関.95・対角分散1。4独立chainset×4chain、burn1024/draw8192、prefix2048/8192。固定.9Lzと.25z、適応なし。

note.ja: 診断engineの独立性とsamplerの独立参照を混同しません。Rhat等は大域収束・被覆の証明ではありません。isotropicは固定比較で失敗を要求せず、banana/funnel/HMC/NUTSは未実装です。
note.en: Diagnostic-engine independence is not an independent sampler. Rhat/ESS/MCSE do not prove global convergence/coverage. Isotropic is descriptive with no required failure;banana/funnel/HMC/NUTSremain unimplemented.

reference_note.ja: 4つのpreconditioned最終prefix全観測量にRhat/ESS/MCSE/既知moment条件。同じ128scalararrayを別ArviZ0.20過程へ渡した640値資格と全データSHAで照合。標的は解析Gaussianモーメントで別検査。 640比較は不変な同一データfixture上で行い、別に生成する8組のfresh軌道で物理・混合判定を行います。環境を跨ぐ生成配列のbit一致は要求しません。
reference_note.en: Gate all full-prefix observables in4preconditioned chainsets by Rhat/ESS/MCSE/knownmoments. Match exact dataSHAand640values from128scalar arrays in a separateArviZ0.20process. Target law is separately checked by analytic Gaussian moments. All640comparisons use the immutable same-data fixture;8freshchainsets independently receive the unchanged physical/mixing gates. No portable generated-byte-identity claim.

method_note.ja: 対称random-walk MH、拒否状態も保持。8観測量それぞれのoriginal-scale meanESS/MCSEを計算し、rankbulkESSを流用しません。
method_note.en: Symmetric random-walk MH retains rejected states. Compute original-scale meanESS/MCSE separately for8observables;rank bulkESS is not substituted.
